title: Latina singer-songwriter Elle Baez presents a brand new single "Pretty Insecurities"
htmlContent:
Latina singer-songwriter Elle Baez shares a new brand single called "Pretty Insecurities", a reminder that even through all the nitpicking and insecurities, you need to try to have a good time because at the end of the day “damn they’re so pretty”. Every second is enjoyable in a major way. She bring that signature flow that pushes the song along well, as they deliver her lyrics that are packed with flows, to make each line as enjoyable as the next, over this hard production.

Elle says, “With the normalcy of plastic surgery & the pressure of social media today, as a body positive artist, I wanted to make an ironic bop that we all relate to when we feel down on ourselves to remind us that we are beautiful inside & out and to go out and live our lives to the fullest while we can”

Elle Baez's "Pretty Insecurities" is a creative song and visual that is hard to turn away from. She don’t waste a single second giving her fans an entertaining experience, that the people need now more than ever on this special piece of audio.

Stream "Pretty Insecurities" by Elle Baez

You can find Ella Baez on Youtube | Spotify | TikTok | Instagram | Website
